summary:
Revised Implementation Plan for Universal Dashboard Overhaul:
1. Context-Adaptive Date Filters: Tailored date switchers per card archetype (Daily switchers: Today, Yesterday, Day Before, 7D Avg for Hourly curves; Monthly/Quarterly switchers: This Month, Last Month, Quarter, Year for Revenue/Cash area curves; Cadence switchers for Histograms and Donut charts).
2. Deep Interactive Charts: High-precision cursor tracking, vertical dashed crosshairs, and rich floating glass tooltips across MonthlyAreaChart, HourlyCurveChart, PillBarHistogram, and DonutChart.
3. Top Header Cleanliness: Removed large global filter; standardized export button to 40px height matching primary buttons.
4. Shortcuts Clean-up: Removed the 3 buttons under 'Raccourcis Opérationnels & Rapports' across all 16 category dashboards, expanding the Guardian intelligence monitor.
